flashcards.front: What is the primary focus of this lecture and the next one?
flashcards.back: Discussing the integration of sensors and actuators with the Arduino platform.

flashcards.front: What is the general function of sensors in IoT systems?
flashcards.back: They convert physical quantities or measurements into electrical signals.

flashcards.front: How can sensors generally be classified?
flashcards.back: Into either analog or digital sensors.

flashcards.front: Name three common types of sensors used with IoT mentioned in the lecture.
flashcards.back: Temperature sensors, humidity sensors, compass or direction sensors, light sensors, sound sensors, accelerometers.

flashcards.front: Which specific sensor and actuator are demonstrated in this lecture?
flashcards.back: The temperature humidity sensor (DHT22) and the servo motor.

flashcards.front: What is the name of the Arduino board used for the sensor integration demonstration?
How many UARTs does an Arduino Mega have, and how does this compare to an Arduino Uno?
flashcards.back: Arduino Mega has four UARTs, while Arduino Uno has only one.

flashcards.front: How many analog input pins does the Arduino Mega have?
What does "DHT" stand for in the context of the sensor used?
How many pins does the DHT sensor typically have?
What is the function of Pin 1 on the DHT sensor when viewed from left to right with the mesh region upfront?
flashcards.back: It is connected to a positive voltage (VCC).

flashcards.front: What is the function of Pin 2 on the DHT sensor?
flashcards.back: It is the signal pin, from which actual sensor data comes to the board.

flashcards.front: What is the function of Pin 4 on the DHT sensor?
What is the recommended voltage supply range for the DHT sensor?
What precaution must be taken regarding the voltage supply to the DHT sensor?
flashcards.back: Do not exceed the 5-volt range, otherwise the sensor will be damaged.

flashcards.front: Which company's library is used for interfacing the DHT sensor with Arduino?
What are the initial steps to install a new library in the Arduino IDE?
flashcards.back: Go to "Sketch" on the menu bar, then "Include Library", and then "Manage Libraries".

flashcards.front: After installing a new library, what action is recommended for the Arduino IDE?
Which digital pin on the Arduino board is used for the DHT sensor's signal wire in the demonstration?
What is the first line of code required in the Arduino sketch to use the DHT sensor library?
How is the DHT sensor object initialized in the Arduino sketch, assuming DHTPIN and DHTTYPE are defined?
What type of variables are used to store humidity and temperature readings?
flashcards.back: Floating type variables (e.g., float humidity; float temperature;).

flashcards.front: What function is called in the setup() part of the sketch to initialize serial communication?
What function is called in the setup() part of the sketch to initialize the DHT sensor?
Which function is used to read the humidity value from the DHT sensor in the loop?
Which function is used to read the temperature value from the DHT sensor in the loop?
What is the delay duration between successive humidity and temperature readings in the example sketch?
What are the expected units for humidity and temperature displayed on the serial monitor?
flashcards.back: Humidity in percentage and temperature in degree Celsius.

flashcards.front: What visual cue on the Arduino board indicates that code is being uploaded?
flashcards.back: The TX and RX lights blink rapidly.

flashcards.front: Besides the DHT sensor, what other types of sensors were mentioned as being integratable with Arduino?
flashcards.back: Light Dependent Resistors (LDRs), light sensors, accelerometers, gyroscopes.
